subject: VALUE clause
notes: kb/Work PB561 - LANDED, RE-MEASURED. 'When a condition-name is referenced in a SET condition-name TO FALSE statement, the value of literal-4 from the FALSE phrase is placed in the associated conditional-variable.' This is the VALUE clause's half of the rule 14.9.39.4 GR7 states from the statement's side, and it failed for ONE reason: literal-4 parsed and was then discarded, so no member of Condition88 held it. DataBinder.BindFalsePhraseOperand now screens the operand through the one 13.18.63.3 SR2/SR4/SR5 literal-position funnel and STORES it on Condition88.FalseValue, which Condition88.CopyOnto carries into every TYPEDEF / SAME AS clone (unit:Condition88CloneDriftTests). Measured end to end: the row's own repro shape prints AFTER-TRUE then the literal-4 value instead of aborting at run time. Landed by e76c275d0 (kb/Work PB555).
